newsitem.title: FRANCE: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: Reuters French Advertising & Media Digest - Aug 5.

text.p: News from Reuters and the French press on Advertising, Marketing, Media & the Internet and Brand-name Products.
PARIS - France has football fever 10 months before it hosts the World Cup tournament next June, and advertisers linked with the event are getting in early on the act. (Reuter)

PARIS - The Commite Francais d'Education pour la Sante (French health education committee) has commissioned a new advertising campaign on AIDS from Australia, with the aim of maintaining concern to help those infected and to encourage protection against transmission of the disease for oneself and others. (Le Figaro)
WASHINGTON - A two-day conference on controlling addresses on the World Wide Web came up with no answer, although the network is saturated and in need of a solution. (Les Echos)

PARIS - The first two French digital video discs (DVDs) have been produced this summer by Editions Montparnasse, with France -- unusally -- hardly lagging the U.S. in the application of a new technology. (La Tribune)

PARIS - Lyonnaise Cable, which operates the Paris cable television network, will from October offer China Central Television, a Beijing channel, and China News and Entertainment, a Hong Kong channel, in Cantonese, Mandarin and English, mainly to Paris's Chinese community in the 13th arrondissement. (Le Figaro)
PARIS - Leroy Merlin, France's number two Do-It-Yourself chain, has introduced an experiment in four of its 73 outlets to provide home delivery and installation of its products. (Les Echos)

PARIS - Kenzo Parfums plans to follow up its first perfume, Jungle l'Elephant, with Jungle le Tigre in mid-September, followed by a third animal in 1999. Next Fathers' Day will see a Tarzan scent. (Le Figaro)
